summary.tagline: Tranquil moorlands and ancient hillforts along the quiet Welsh border.
summary.best_season: Check official seasonal access before choosing dates

travel.headline: Check Local Council and National Trust Site Regulations
travel.reservation: The National Landscape is a working area always open to the public without a single entry permit. However, specific sites managed by Forestry England or the National Trust may require parking fees or have site-specific rules. Accommodation and campsites should be booked directly via local provider lists or visitor centers.

intel.title: Town and Site Parking
intel.text: Pay and display car parks are located in towns like Church Stretton, Ludlow, and Clun. Smaller car parks are available at National Trust and Forestry England sites, but capacity is not guaranteed.

intel.title: Coverage Check
intel.text: The reviewed official sources do not establish mobile coverage at these stops. Save directions before departure rather than assuming reception.

intel.title: Fuel and Supplies
intel.text: The reviewed official sources do not establish fuel-station locations or operating hours. Check your refuelling options independently before departure.

intel.title: Seasonal Wildlife
intel.text: The landscape contains grazing land and ground-nesting birds. Follow the Countryside Code and check current route conditions; the sources do not establish a best wildlife-viewing time.

intel.title: Public Transport
intel.text: Regular trains serve Church Stretton and Craven Arms from Shrewsbury. Local buses connect these hubs to smaller villages, though services are less frequent.

plan.arrival: The official FAQ describes rail services through Church Stretton and Craven Arms from Shrewsbury and Ludlow. Verify the current timetable and access to your chosen walk before travelling.
plan.vehicle: The reviewed sources do not establish rental or motorhome suitability on every approach road. Check your provider, the actual roads and each site’s vehicle restrictions before departure.
plan.goldenHour: For a suggested late-day visit at Long Mynd, check daylight, closing times and current access first. A sunset view or after-hours admission is not established by these sources.
